purpose: Rebaseline Leshy2 around direct S3 UI, maximum legal display throughput, one additional RP2354B hub, optional analog 5.8-GHz FPV reception and mandatory receive-only 118-137-MHz Airband AM without losing the accepted radio, expansion, safety, service, audio or storage capabilities.

accepted_scope.user_acceptance: Analog 5.8-GHz FPV is accepted if the remaining architecture stays optimal; display performance is maximized and ordinary UI buttons remain directly owned by S3.
accepted_scope.fpv: Receive-only analog NTSC/PAL FPV. DJI, Walksnail, HDZero and other proprietary digital video systems are outside R2.
accepted_scope.external_rf_interface: User-facing MMCX labelled FPV RX 5.8G; U.FL is permitted only as an internal module interconnect.
accepted_scope.production_boundary: The base PCB contains the video decoder and a replaceable receiver bay. The exact serial 5.8-GHz receiver module and exact MMCX MPN must close in H1 before placement is accepted.
accepted_scope.airband_acceptance: Mandatory receive-only AM reception from 118 to 137 MHz reuses the existing FM/SW antenna port and Si4732 audio path. Airband transmit, VDL Mode 2 and certified navigation are excluded.

compute_domains.role: application, direct UI, touch, encoder, maximum legal QSPI display path, analog-video capture and native 2.4-GHz Wi-Fi/BLE
three fully concurrent nRF24 paths, CC1101, independent VHF/UHF voice radios and U214/LoRa Cap
dedicated high-speed fan-out for C5, RF RP, microSD, audio, FM/AM/SW/LW plus converted Airband receiver and generic M5 Unit port
cell admission, pack diagnostics and protected shutdown
independent watchdog, thermal supervision, TX lease/evidence and FAULT_KILL

retained_capabilities.result: HMX035CTFT-001, touch, sixteen ordinary UI inputs and encoder remain local to S3; no UI event crosses IPC
dedicated direct QSPI with GDMA; microSD no longer shares SPI2
receive-only 5.8-GHz analog video enters S3 directly through an active production video decoder and LCD_CAM camera mode
raw/demodulated receive, learning and transmit retained
3R, 1T2R, 2T1R and 3T concurrency retained on independent buses
independent SA818S-V and SA818S-U paths with hardware one-hot selection retained
U214 and qualified regional Leshy LoRa Cap contracts retained
Si4732 FM/SW plus separate AM/LW input retained; mandatory receive-only 118-137-MHz Airband AM is downconverted to the supported 6-25-MHz FMI range
full-duplex codec, microphone, speaker and CTIA headset retained
dedicated powered and isolated microSD path retained without display contention
generic powered I2C/UART/GPIO Unit port retained independently from U214
RUN/KILL, watchdog suicide shutdown, three thermal zones, TX evidence and retained first-fault display contract remain mandatory
S3, C5, RF RP and Hub RP each retain independent USB plus physical reset/boot recovery; Pack and Safety retain isolated SWD/UART/NRST fixtures

pin_map.gate: decoder data output must be high-Z through strap sampling
hub held reset/high-Z through strap sampling
only bounded internal UI/power/safety open-drain sources; external Unit and RF control are excluded
external pull preserves the accepted strap

ui_contract.ordinary_buttons: All sixteen independent active-low inputs terminate on the local TCA9539PWR. Its 400-kHz I2C and dedicated active-low interrupt connect directly to S3; there is no Hub/RF-RP message hop and no polling-only path.
ui_contract.encoder: A/B remain dedicated S3 PCNT inputs; encoder push is one TCA9539 input.
ui_contract.ptt_exception: PTT remains direct to RF RP for fail-safe radio control and is mirrored to S3 as state/event data.
ui_contract.latency_target: button edge to S3 event <=1 ms and first visible response <=20 ms under qualified concurrent load
ui_contract.bus_priority: After UI_FAULT_INT_N, button/touch source identification preempts the next bounded internal I2C transaction. No external hot-plug bus is connected to this branch.

pin_groups.role: dedicated SPI plus ALERT to RF RP
Hub-local I2C for codec, Si4732, headset, video decoder and slow controls
dedicated microSD SPI SCK/MOSI/MISO/CS plus power and detect
FPV RSSI ADC, receiver power and lock/evidence
receiver channel-control reserve for the selected exact serial module
AIR_RX_EN fail-low switched-domain and LT5560 enable control
AIR_RX_MODE direct-FM/SW versus converted-Airband RF selector; reset default is direct FM/SW
dedicated fail-closed I2C controller bus to Pack and Safety MSPM0 mailboxes

hub_rp.service: Independent native USB, SWD, RUN and USB_BOOT remain mandatory; the diagnostic UART reserve is not a substitute for USB/SWD recovery.

transport_contracts.reason: Carries control and selected data only; display and analog video never traverse IPC.

transport_contracts.service_mux: C5 GPIO13/14 are switched between SDIO D3/D2 and the independent service USB connector; service mode stops and resets the runtime link before switching.

transport_contracts.reason: The worst accepted simultaneous three-nRF/CC payload remains below this floor and never shares its peripheral with storage or C5.
The existing accepted recording requirement is met without using the S3 display peripheral or crossing S3_HUB for local captures.
Carries Pack read-only state and Safety heartbeat/lease/fault mailboxes; local Safety hardware still owns watchdog service and asynchronous FAULT_KILL.

display_contract.interface: dedicated direct QSPI on S3 SPI2 with GDMA and TE
display_contract.s3_supported_sources: ESP32-S3 GPSPI uses APB 80 MHz or XTAL 40 MHz in the locked ESP-IDF. The fastest normal divided clock not exceeding 62.5 MHz is therefore 40 MHz; 80 MHz would violate the panel timing.
display_contract.video_window: 320x240 RGB565 at 30 fps is 4.608 MB/s and 23.04% of the selected QSPI payload
display_contract.maximality_result: 40 MHz is the maximum datasheet-legal clock obtainable from the supported S3 GPSPI sources without panel overclocking. Parallel i8080 is rejected in R2 because it would consume the shared LCD_CAM camera resource needed by direct analog video capture.
display_contract.hil: Route and tune for the 40-MHz guaranteed mode; measure edges, TE scheduling, full-frame and dirty-region latency under simultaneous camera DMA before accepting any non-standard clock experiment.

video_contract.rf: replaceable exact serial analog 5.8-GHz receiver module; generic RX5808 is evidence input, not an accepted MPN
video_contract.external_connector: MMCX, DC to at least 6 GHz, user-facing and labelled FPV RX 5.8G
video_contract.decoder: Texas Instruments TVP5150AM1PBS or industrial-temperature TVP5150AM1IPBS after factory-route confirmation
video_contract.capture: 8-bit BT.601/BT.656-compatible YUV422 plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF into S3 LCD_CAM and GDMA; hardware YUV422-to-RGB565 conversion is required
video_contract.first_acceptance_mode: NTSC/PAL source to centered 320x240 live view at source frame rate with UI overlay/remaining portrait area; uncompressed full-source recording is not promised
video_contract.coexistence: Entering FPV mode powers the receiver/decoder group, disables C5 5-GHz RF and all unused transmit groups, and preserves the one-active-signal-group rule.
video_contract.power_thermal_gate: Receiver, decoder, regulator and local shielding are added to the unattended thermal and battery budgets before H1 acceptance.

airband_contract.antenna_port: the existing outward standard-SMA port is relabelled FM / SW / AIR RX; no eleventh antenna connector is added
airband_contract.signal_group: BROADCAST_RX remains the exclusive top-level receive group; FM, SW, AM/LW and AIR are mutually exclusive submodes
rf_chain: shared FM/SW/AIR SMA protection and mode split
existing Si4732-A10-GSR FMI and audio path

frequency_plan.image_rejection_rule: The 118-137-MHz input filter is mandatory because the fixed low-side LO maps the 87-106-MHz FM broadcast band onto the same IF range.

control.i2c: SI5351A-B-GTR joins the isolated Hub-local I2C bus at address 0x60; it does not share S3 UI I2C
control.gp41: AIR_RX_EN is pulled low and removes the Airband RF/LO domain when unused
control.gp42: AIR_RX_MODE defaults to the direct FM/SW path before Hub firmware starts
control.quiet_state: Airband LNA, mixer and LO are electrically off outside AIR mode; inactive RF paths cannot clock or load the selected receiver input

performance_boundary.hil: H1 simulation and H7 injection tests must prove sensitivity, blocker tolerance, LO leakage, image rejection across 118-137 MHz and direct-FM/SW degradation before the path is accepted.

lines.role: existing FM/AM/SW/LW receiver reused for 6-25-MHz IF
lines.route: existing R1 line; no incremental quantity

filter_route.production_implementation: serial high-Q LC passives from the current JLCPCB library, selected after H1 synthesis, tolerance/finite-Q simulation and layout extraction
filter_route.acceptance_mask: <=4.5-dB insertion loss from 118 to 137 MHz and blocker/image rejection not worse than the BPF-A127+ reference at the named H1/H7 test points
filter_route.order_gate: every passive MPN, live factory route, stock, MOQ and cost must be rechecked before architecture freeze and again before order

power_rebaseline.r1_status: The reviewed R1 2.493-A worst state and 2.5-A continuous rail are historical only because R2 adds an always-present Hub RP plus FPV and Airband domains.

airband_increment.rail: switched low-noise 3.0-V RF domain plus Hub-local 3.3-V control
airband_increment.basis: PGA-103+ 60 mA at 3 V; LT5560 up to 12 mA at 3 V; SI5351 core plus one output up to 40.6 mA; selector/control/filter margin included

power_rebaseline.coexistence: FPV and Airband are never powered together; both remain mutually exclusive with unused transmit groups under the one-active-signal-group rule.

h1_required_envelope.action: recalculate the complete six-domain rail/state matrix and requalify the buck, eFuse threshold, inductor, copper and thermal path before retaining or replacing the R1 parts

reopen_effect.hardware: R1 H1 through H5 artifacts remain historical evidence only. Current work resumes at H1-R2.0 after this reviewed H0-R2 contract.
reopen_effect.firmware: The previous five-image H2/F2 contract is superseded. R2 has six firmware domains and requires a Hub target, new transports and analog-video/display scheduling before F1-R2 can close.
reopen_effect.ordering: All prior sample baskets and factory-route counts are non-current; no purchase or PCB layout is authorized by H0-R2.

exit_review.display: maximum legal supported S3 QSPI clock, no shared client
exit_review.ui: local interrupt-driven S3 ownership, no IPC
exit_review.video: direct capture path with exact active decoder and replaceable receiver boundary
open_h1_gates: select an exact current serial 5.8-GHz receiver module with controlled pinout and lifecycle
select exact edge MMCX MPN and cable/launch geometry
prove receiver bay, shielding, power and thermal fit in the dimensioned sandwich
select exact DVP reset/strap isolation and C5 USB/SDIO switching components
synthesize the factory-stock Airband LC filter, extract its layout and prove the BPF-A127+ acceptance mask including 87-106-MHz image rejection
recalculate the six-domain 3.3-V state matrix against the new >=3.5-A continuous and >=4.0-A step contract
regenerate every physical view and inter-board contact budget before H1-R2 acceptance
